coordinates.note: The design paper states the position of the selected area only to 0.1 degree ("an area near 114.0 E, 17.4 N", about 10 km), so the precision is generous; the point is the centre of the area, not a surveyed string position.
coordinates.quote: an area near 114.0◦ E, 17.4◦ N was selected as a suitable location to build a large scale deep-sea detector

depth.quote: A favorable neutrino telescope site was found on an abyssal plain at a depth of ∼ 3.5 km.

place.region: North-eastern South China Sea (western Pacific Ocean)

summary.plain: A patch of flat deep seabed about 3.5 kilometres below the surface of the north-eastern South China Sea where the TRIDENT neutrino telescope is planned.
summary.technical: Abyssal-plain site at ~3.5 km depth near 114.0 E, 17.4 N; the planned array occupies 2800-3400 m below sea level.
